profiles.label: Religious facilities
profiles.area_defined: All worship buildings and worship areas; include courtyards only when the source ties the count to worship or evacuation.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during services, prayers, meetings, and staff work periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for mosques, churches, synagogues, temples, and other worship facilities. Good evidence includes congregants, worshippers, attendees, visitors, staff, or clergy present, evacuated, rescued, checked in, or attending a bounded service or gathering. Treat capacity and membership as context only.

profiles.label: Museums and historic sites
profiles.area_defined: All buildings and areas open to visitors; exclude ruins or closed areas visitors cannot access.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during visitor hours and staff work periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for museums, museum buildings, galleries, and archaeological or historic sites open to visitors. Good evidence includes visitors, attendees, employees, or staff present, evacuated, checked in, or attending a bounded event. Treat annual visitors, capacity, and ticket sales as context only.

profiles.label: Public libraries
profiles.area_defined: All public library areas; exclude coffee shops or other facilities inside the library unless the count is explicitly tied to the library occupancy.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open to visitors, readers, staff, and employees.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for local, city, county, state, national, and public libraries. Good evidence includes patrons, visitors, attendees, employees, or staff present, evacuated, checked in, or attending a bounded library event. Treat collection size, capacity, and annual visitors as context only.

profiles.label: Hospitals and clinics with beds
profiles.area_defined: All hospital or inpatient clinic buildings.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open with in-patients, out-patients, doctors, nurses, staff, and visitors.
profiles.night_occurrence: Open with in-patients, bed occupancy, reduced employees, and limited visitation.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for hospitals, surgery centers, and inpatient clinics. Good evidence includes patients, in-patients, out-patients, doctors, nurses, staff, or visitors present, evacuated, transferred, rescued, or reported in a dated occupancy or incident record. Treat licensed beds and bed capacity as context only unless reported as current occupied beds.

profiles.label: Clinics without beds
profiles.area_defined: All outpatient clinic and doctors' office buildings.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open with out-patients, doctors, nurses, staff, and visitors.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for clinics, doctors' offices, outpatient medical centers, and treatment facilities without overnight stays. Good evidence includes patients, out-patients, doctors, nurses, staff, or visitors present, evacuated, rescued, or counted during a bounded clinic event or incident.

profiles.label: Public service and government buildings
profiles.area_defined: All government-operated service buildings not better classified as library, court, police, prison, museum, or other specific PDT category.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open with employees and public visitors.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for city halls, town halls, government assembly halls, government service offices, and legislative buildings. Good evidence includes employees, visitors, staff, or members of the public present, evacuated, rescued, or attending a bounded public meeting or incident.

profiles.label: Police, fire, courts, and prisons
profiles.pdt_subtype: Police Stations / Fire Stations / Courts / Prisons
profiles.area_defined: All buildings for the selected public-safety or justice facility; prisons exclude courtyards unless the source ties the count to the occupied facility area.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open or operational with employees, prisoners, visitors, or service users depending on subtype.
profiles.night_occurrence: Operational or closed depending on subtype; prisons and fire stations remain operational with reduced staff.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for police stations, fire stations, courts, jails, and prisons. Good evidence includes employees, officers, firefighters, court staff, visitors, prisoners, or inmates present, evacuated, transferred, on duty, or counted in a bounded record. Treat jail/prison capacity and staffing totals as context only unless reported as current occupancy or on-duty presence.

profiles.label: Civil protection shelters
profiles.area_defined: Only areas of the building used as a shelter for which count or capacity is reported.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during shelter activation or preparedness events.
contextual_count_fields: registered evacuees not tied to shelter
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for bunkers, bomb shelters, tornado shelters, earthquake shelters, typhoon shelters, and civil protection shelters. Good evidence includes evacuees, shelter occupants, people seeking shelter, staff, or volunteers present, checked in, sheltered, or evacuated during a bounded emergency. Treat designed capacity as context only unless the source says current occupancy.
